verdict.rationale: The documented read surfaces let a user programmatically pull their ledger data as typed JSON, a de facto open format: chart of accounts, ledger entry queries, trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow and A/R/A/P aging. These sit behind OAuth-scoped read access with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, plus a read-only MCP server over the user's own account. However, the evidence shows no first-party bulk export, offboarding, or 'download everything' feature; the only migration content is inbound from QuickBooks. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-data export, explicit open file formats (CSV/XLSX/standard accounting exports) for ledger, documents, bills and invoices, a documented account-exit/offboarding process, and independent corroboration that complete data can be extracted.
